_about: Editorial rulings applied by scripts/partners-photos.mjs on top of the researchers' manifest.json files (2026-11-16). Edit here, then re-run the script; never hand-edit the generated <slug>.json files.

kochi-heritage-project.summary: The Kochi Heritage Project is a small-group heritage walk and event organiser in Kochi. Its walks cover Fort Kochi and Mattancherry, tracing the city's story as an Indian Ocean port.
kochi-heritage-project._why: The manifest names the guide; we never publish practitioner names.

skinessence.summary: Skinessence is a skin, hair and laser clinic in Kadavanthra, Kochi. Its site lists skin, hair and laser treatments offered after a dermatologist assessment.
skinessence._why: The manifest summary names a practitioner; we never publish practitioner names.
